The test image shows a corn stalk/leaf sheath with large irregular lesions featuring tan/brown centers with dark black borders. Multiple lesions of varying sizes are visible on the green stalk tissue.

Top candidates: Physoderma_Brown_Spot (dark-bordered lesions on stalk/sheath), Anthracnose_Leaf_Spot_And_Top_Dieback, Eyespot.

Let me view reference images one at a time.

This Physoderma Brown Spot reference shows small yellow spots and midrib darkening on the leaf blade — doesn't match the large stalk lesions in the test image. Let me check Physoderma Stalk Rot and Anthracnose.
Physoderma Stalk Rot shows dense purple-black spotting — different from the test image's large tan-centered lesions. Let me check Anthracnose.
This Anthracnose reference shows advanced stalk rot — doesn't match. Let me check Eyespot and Holcus Spot.
Eyespot shows many tiny circular spots — not a match for the large lesions in the test. Let me check Holcus Spot.

Holcus Spot shows a single round whitish spot — not a match. The test image lesions are large, irregularly shaped with tan centers and dark borders on the stalk/sheath. Let me check Carbonum Leaf Spot and Tar Spot.
Tar Spot shows tiny black dots — not a match. Let me check another Physoderma Brown Spot reference, as the test image shows lesions on the leaf sheath (not blade).

This Physoderma Brown Spot reference (Corn_Disease_109.jpg) shows dark lesions on the stalk/leaf sheath — much closer to the test image. The location (stalk/sheath area), dark black lesions with tan/brown tissue involvement all match well.

**Summary of evidence:**
- Test image: large irregular lesions with tan centers and distinct dark black borders on green stalk/leaf sheath
- Physoderma Brown Spot (109): dark lesions on stalk/sheath area — best visual match
- Physoderma Stalk Rot: dense purple-black dotting, no large tan-centered lesions
- Anthracnose: advanced stalk rot, uniformly brown/black tissue, no discrete bordered lesions
- Eyespot: tiny circular spots on leaf blade
- Holcus Spot: single round whitish spot on leaf blade
- Carbonum Leaf Spot: small elongated brown streaks on leaf blade
- Tar Spot: tiny raised black dots on leaf blade

The stalk/sheath location with discrete dark-bordered lesions having tan centers is characteristic of Physoderma Brown Spot.
